name: Audius Governance proxy re-initialization
summary: AudiusAdminUpgradeabilityProxy stores proxyAdmin in slot 0, where the logic contracts' Initializable keeps its initialized/initializing flags; with the admin address's low bytes nonzero, initializer guards always pass. The attacker re-initialized Governance, Staking and DelegateManagerV2, delegated fake stake to itself, and passed a proposal moving the treasury's AUDIO.
notes: The anchor re-ran the initializers of Staking (0xe6d97b20) and DelegateManagerV2 (0x4d7968eb), then used DelegateManager.delegateStake with a fake token to gain the voting stake; both proxies carry the same slot-0 collision, so they are targets. DelegateManagerV2's upgrade is the latest route change and sets the age.

The anchor (first harmful re-initialization, rule 12) only set up proposal 84; the second round re-initialized again, voted proposal 85 and moved the AUDIO in 0x4227bca8. Earlier, 0xaeb62d01 called the no-argument initialize() on DelegateManager and Staking (Dec 2021) without effect or loss, so it is not an exploit.
AUDIO is valued at the attacker's realised 704.18 ETH from one Uniswap V2 sale (0x82fc2399) that took AUDIO from about 0.367 to 0.059 USD; spot marking would give 6.8M USD.
